facts.value: These events aim to convey communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge of the English language, and provide the subject vocabulary as well as an initial insight into general aspects of the economy in English-speaking countries.

facts.value: The FOUNDATION level consists of the course WE1A. All Foundation courses have the same level of difficulty (target level B1.2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages) and are thematically identical. They are suitable for students who have very little or no knowledge of business English.
